instruction: Place the test questions from the PDF into the provided Word template, matching the question formatting in the Word document.

dim1: The deliverable is in .docx format and can be opened normally.
dim2: +1: Page setup for the entire Word document: A4 paper in portrait orientation, with a page width of 21 cm and a height of 29.7 cm; top margin 1 cm, bottom margin 0.8 cm, left margin 1.3 cm, and right margin 1.3 cm. A thin light-blue rectangular border appears around all four sides of each page, positioned inside the page edges, with a line width of 1 pt; the page body text and page numbers are both inside the border.

+1: Top headers on Pages 1 through 5: The decorative pinyin phrase and the Chinese phrase in the top header use Times New Roman and Noto Sans CJK SC, respectively, at 8.5 pt, in gray-blue, and are horizontally centered.

+5: Title area at the top of Page 1: An editable 1-row, 2-column Word table is used at the top. The left cell has a light-blue fill, the right cell has a light-orange fill, and both columns have thin, solid, light-blue borders. Left-side title text: The left title area sequentially displays “Third Grade, Second Semester Chinese Language Proficiency Test Paper” in Noto Sans CJK SC, Chinese font size Small One, bold, and dark blue, followed by “Unit Four Test Paper” and “Time: 60 minutes　Maximum Score: 100 points” in Noto Sans CJK SC, Chinese font size Five, and gray. The pinyin above “Third Grade, Second Semester Chinese Language Proficiency Test Paper” is in Times New Roman, Chinese font size Small Five, and italic. Right-side student information: The right title area displays “School: ********”, “Class: ********”, “Name: ********”, and “Score: ********” on separate lines, in Noto Sans CJK SC at 9.5 pt, black, and horizontally centered.

+1: Exam information callout on Page 1: A light-yellow cell is placed below the title area and displays “Challenge Tip: Please carefully spell out and read each question, write neatly, and read neutral-tone syllables and syllables recognized as whole units several more times when you encounter them.” Within it, “Challenge Tip” is in Noto Sans CJK SC, Chinese font size Five, bold, and dark orange; “Please carefully spell out and read each question, write neatly, and read neutral-tone syllables and syllables recognized as whole units several more times when you encounter them.” is in Noto Serif CJK SC, Chinese font size Five.

+1: Score summary table on Page 1: An editable 2-row, 11-column Word table is used. The first row sequentially displays “Question Number, One, Two, Three, Four, Five, Six, Seven, Eight, Nine, Total Score”; the second row displays “Score” followed by 10 blank score cells. The table has complete borders, uses Noto Sans CJK SC in Chinese font size Five, and the text is horizontally and vertically centered.
+3: Outer borders for the major-question modules on Pages 1 through 4: Each major question uses a single-column editable Word table with a width of 18.4 cm and a light-blue 0.5 pt solid border.

+3: The First, Fourth, and Seventh major-question modules have a very light-blue background fill, and their Chinese titles use Noto Sans CJK SC at 13.5 pt, bold, and blue; the Second, Fifth, and Eighth major-question modules have a very light-green background fill, and their Chinese titles use Noto Sans CJK SC at 13.5 pt, bold, and green; the Third, Sixth, and Ninth major-question modules have a very light-orange background fill, and their Chinese titles use Noto Sans CJK SC at 13.5 pt, bold, and orange.

+1: Pinyin titles for the major questions on Pages 1 through 4: The complete corresponding pinyin appears above the Chinese title of each major question, in Times New Roman at 8.5 pt, italic, and gray. The pinyin and Chinese title are within the same module.
+1: Question body text on Pages 1 through 4: Chinese text uses Noto Serif CJK SC in Chinese font size Five, black, with single line spacing, 0 pt before paragraphs, and 0 pt after paragraphs.
+1: Footer page numbers on Pages 1 through 4: The footer displays “Page 1/Total 4 Pages” through “Page 4/Total 4 Pages”, centered, in SimSun or Noto Serif CJK SC at 8.5 pt, in gray.

+3: Pagination order for Pages 1 through 4: Page 1 contains the First through Third major questions; Page 2 contains the Fourth through Sixth major questions; Page 3 contains the Seventh major question and the first half of the reading passage; Page 4 contains the second half of the reading passage and the Ninth major question.
